verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents one autonomous background automation of its own: inbound emails are automatically parsed and routed using rules and webhooks. The Scheduled Messages API covers one-off deferred sends, not recurring or general-purpose automations, and webhooks are event notifications rather than user-defined automations. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder (triggers, conditions, actions), recurring schedules, agent-driven background tasks, in-depth docs on rule configuration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
Keep track of scheduled messages using MailerSend's Scheduled Messages API endpoint.
